title: Reference emulator implementations
summary: Secondary implementation evidence for translating KL10 behavior into emulator code after the architectural and guest-source contracts are understood.
procedure: Compare the closest matching processor mode and paging mode, not just the instruction mnemonic.
Extract the smallest relevant behavior from the reference implementation and verify it against DEC documentation.
Where reference emulators disagree, prefer the primary architecture/microcode evidence and keep the disagreement explicit.
invariants: Reference code is evidence, not proof.
Do not copy a model-A or KI/KS behavior into Model-B solely because the opcode matches.
Preserve guest-visible error/status timing where it affects TOPS-20 control flow.
